acronyms.description: GlitchTip groups similar issue events into a single issue. The audit catalog identifies groups by numeric GlitchTip issue ID and never exposes issue titles or individual events.
acronyms.name: GlitchTip Issue Group

acronyms.description: Releases with a recorded release time, grouped by project and UTC hour. This groups release activity without returning version strings or treating release records as proof of a deployment.
acronyms.name: GlitchTip Release Cohort

customAnalyses.description: Recorded issue-event volume per project and UTC hour for the last 24 complete hours. GlitchTip's project counters do not distinguish severity. Returns up to 240 observed project-hours, newest first.
customAnalyses.name: GlitchTip hourly error volume by project
customAnalyses.sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'UTC') AS end_hour)
SELECT project_id, hour_start, event_count
FROM glitchtip_audit.project_hourly_errors CROSS JOIN bounds
WHERE hour_start >= end_hour - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND hour_start < end_hour
ORDER BY hour_start DESC, event_count DESC, project_id
LIMIT 240

customAnalyses.description: Top 25 issue groups by absolute increase in recorded events over the last seven complete days compared with the preceding seven days, aligned to the UTC hour. A missing baseline contributes zero recorded events. An increase is not a GlitchTip reopen transition.
customAnalyses.name: GlitchTip 7d top regressing issues
customAnalyses.sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'UTC') AS end_hour),
event_totals AS (
  SELECT project_id, issue_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(event_count) FILTER (WHERE hour_start >= end_hour - INTERVAL '168 hours'), 0) AS recent_events,
    COALESCE(SUM(event_count) FILTER (WHERE hour_start < end_hour - INTERVAL '168 hours'), 0) AS prior_events
  FROM glitchtip_audit.issue_hourly_events CROSS JOIN bounds
  WHERE hour_start >= end_hour - INTERVAL '336 hours' AND hour_start < end_hour
  GROUP BY project_id, issue_id
)
SELECT project_id, issue_id, recent_events, prior_events, recent_events - prior_events AS event_increase
FROM event_totals
WHERE recent_events > prior_events
ORDER BY event_increase DESC, project_id, issue_id
LIMIT 25

customAnalyses.description: Compare recorded project issue events in the 24 complete hours before and after a release cohort, excluding its release hour. Consider the latest 100 eligible project-hours from the last 30 days; show up to 50 ordered by event increase. Overlapping windows and missing counters limit inference; this is temporal correlation, not attribution.
customAnalyses.name: GlitchTip release regression correlation
customAnalyses.sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'UTC') AS end_hour),
recent_releases AS (
  SELECT project_id, release_hour, releases
  FROM glitchtip_audit.project_release_activity CROSS JOIN bounds
  WHERE release_hour >= end_hour - INTERVAL '720 hours' AND release_hour <= end_hour - INTERVAL '25 hours'
  ORDER BY release_hour DESC, project_id
  LIMIT 100
), release_windows AS (
  SELECT r.project_id, r.release_hour, r.releases,
    COALESCE(SUM(h.event_count) FILTER (WHERE h.hour_start < r.release_hour), 0) AS before_events,
    COALESCE(SUM(h.event_count) FILTER (WHERE h.hour_start > r.release_hour), 0) AS after_events
  FROM recent_releases AS r CROSS JOIN bounds
  LEFT JOIN glitchtip_audit.project_hourly_errors AS h
    ON h.project_id = r.project_id
    AND h.hour_start >= end_hour - INTERVAL '744 hours' AND h.hour_start < end_hour
    AND h.hour_start >= r.release_hour - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    AND h.hour_start < r.release_hour + INTERVAL '25 hours'
  GROUP BY r.project_id, r.release_hour, r.releases
)
SELECT project_id, release_hour, releases, before_events, after_events, after_events - before_events AS event_delta
FROM release_windows
ORDER BY event_delta DESC, release_hour DESC, project_id
LIMIT 50

customAnalyses.description: Counts currently unresolved issue groups by elapsed time since first seen: under seven, seven to under thirty, and at least thirty days. Includes the total non-deleted issue groups for each project with an unresolved issue, ranked by oldest backlog. Returns up to 100 projects.
customAnalyses.name: GlitchTip unresolved issue aging
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT a.project_id, p.issues, a.unresolved_issues, a.under_7_days, a.days_7_to_29, a.at_least_30_days
FROM glitchtip_audit.unresolved_issue_aging AS a
JOIN glitchtip_audit.project_issue_counts AS p ON p.project_id = a.project_id
ORDER BY a.at_least_30_days DESC, a.unresolved_issues DESC, a.project_id
LIMIT 100

rules.description: Query only the six aggregate views in glitchtip_audit via glitchtip-pg-ro. Do not ingest the public schema, raw issue payloads, user data, billing, authentication, sessions, or tokens.
rules.name: GlitchTip standby audit boundary

rules.description: Use complete UTC hours for comparisons. Counter increases do not establish reopen status, and release-window comparisons do not establish cause. Consider retention, ingestion gaps and standby lag before drawing conclusions.
rules.name: GlitchTip regression evidence limits
